headline: Argentina country risk jumps near 1,100 bps as dollar bonds fall 7%
summary: Argentina's country risk index scaled 230 basis points higher toward 1,100, while sovereign dollar bonds dropped 7% in a negative week. The financial pressure coincides with electoral uncertainty and rising US yields.
why: Argentina is a major Latin American economy that frequently accesses international debt restructuring. Country risk measures the yield spread investors demand over US Treasuries.

impacts.name: Argentina Country Risk Index
impacts.why: The JP Morgan sovereign risk benchmark rose by 230 basis points toward 1,100 points.
